correctness.rationale: Polynomial integration yields Delta=(462b+11ab-33b²-5a²)/6930 exactly. The discriminant gives two roots; b_minus is in (0,1/80), b_plus makes density negative at 1/2. For a<=0, concavity in u=x(1-x) reduces strict positivity to two positive endpoint values; for a>=0 use L4>=-3/7 and L2>=-1/2. The kernel is bounded; conditional projection derivative is F(x)+x-1, nonconstant on every positive-density alternative, so the order-two U-statistic CLT applies with 4Var_F Q_F. Null variance is 1/45. The a=-1 value is an exact algebraic density and its high-precision quadrature gives variance 0.01503693250994 and limiting 5% power 0.01718802635. Standalone symbolic and high-precision checker passed 8617 assertions; numerical grids do not replace the positivity proof or CLT.

value.rationale: The source frames its single signed contrast as discriminating uniformity. The theorem provides a continuum of positive smooth nonuniform alternatives where that claim fails and a fully evaluated member with rejection probability 1.7188% at nominal 5%, a consequential test-calibration pathology. The branch uniqueness among nonnegative two-mode polynomial densities makes the example systematic. This is distinct from routine test recasting, and the result does not claim coverage of the censored version or unknown endpoints.
